import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[][] dirs = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static final int MAXNODES = 1000;
    static final int MAXEDGES = 2000000;

    static class FlowEdge {
        int to, cap, rev_idx;
        FlowEdge(int to, int cap, int rev_idx) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.rev_idx = rev_idx;
        }
    }

    static List<FlowEdge>[] graph = new List[MAXNODES];
    static int S, T, n_grid, t_limit, INF_VAL;
    static int[][] dist_map = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dep_map = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] node_ids = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] sink_ids = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] mazeA = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] mazeB = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] ptr = new int[MAXNODES];

    static void link_nodes(int u, int v, int cap) {
        graph[u].add(new FlowEdge(v, cap, graph[v].size()));
        graph[v].add(new FlowEdge(u, 0, graph[u].size() - 1));
    }

    static void bfs_expand(int sx, int sy, boolean phase2) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist_map[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
        }
        INF_VAL = dist_map[0][0];
        dist_map[sx][sy] = 0;
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            
            if (phase2 && sink_ids[x][y] != 0 && dist_map[x][y] <= t_limit && dist_map[x][y] <= dep_map[x][y]) {
                link_nodes(node_ids[x][y], sink_ids[x][y], INF_VAL);
            }
            
            if (dist_map[x][y] > t_limit || dist_map[x][y] >= dep_map[x][y]) continue;
            
            if (node_ids[x][y] == 3 && sink_ids[x][y] == 9) {
                System.out.println(dist_map[x][y]);
            }
            
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dirs[k][0];
                int ny = y + dirs[k][1];
                if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n_grid && ny >= 1 && ny <= n_grid && 
                    Character.isDigit(mazeA[nx][ny]) && dist_map[nx][ny] == INF_VAL) {
                    dist_map[nx][ny] = dist_map[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean level_bfs() {
        int[] lvl = new int[MAXNODES];
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(S);
        lvl[S] = 1;
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (FlowEdge e : graph[u]) {
                if (lvl[e.to] == 0 && e.cap > 0) {
                    lvl[e.to] = lvl[u] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                    if (e.to == T) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs_flow(int u, int flow, int[] lvl) {
        if (u == T) return flow;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < graph[u].size(); i++) {
            ptr[u] = i;
            FlowEdge e = graph[u].get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && lvl[e.to] == lvl[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = dfs_flow(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap), lvl);
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    graph[e.to].get(e.rev_idx).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        t_limit = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        n_grid = n;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                mazeA[i][j+1] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                mazeB[i][j+1] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXNODES; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dep_map[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (mazeA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs_expand(i, j, false);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(dist_map[i], 0, dep_map[i], 0, MAXN);
        }
        
        int node_cnt = 1;
        S = 0;
        T = 1;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (mazeA[i][j] > '0' && mazeA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    node_ids[i][j] = ++node_cnt;
                    link_nodes(S, node_ids[i][j], mazeA[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (mazeB[i][j] > '0' && mazeB[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sink_ids[i][j] = ++node_cnt;
                    link_nodes(sink_ids[i][j], T, mazeB[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (node_ids[i][j] != 0) {
                    bfs_expand(i, j, true);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int max_flow = 0;
        while (level_bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int[] lvl = new int[MAXNODES];
            lvl[S] = 1;
            
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs_flow(S, INF_VAL, lvl);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                max_flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_flow);
    }
}
